architecture.text_side: TextStudent2 cfg b (shared-weight transformer encoder, depthwise-conv duration branch, BiLSTM F0/N stack, asr MLP into the teacher's 512-d space)
architecture.decoder: AdaIN trunk width 128 (preset D) + source-filter head v4 (ConvNeXt width 160; 64-harmonic closed-form sine bank on the 300-point STFT grid, one shared inverse STFT, TF-domain plain noise drawn as rows of a 2^17 session-start table; no pulsed or burst paths)
architecture.packing: int4-g32 / int6 / int8 weights unpacked at session start; 24 GEMMs as dynamic int8 (7-bit weights); noise from a Gaussian table generated at session start

onnx_alternatives.paradee_v2f_noint8.onnx: v2f weights, fp32 compute (no int8 GEMMs)
onnx_alternatives.paradee_v2e_noint8.onnx: v2e weights, fp32 compute (no int8 GEMMs)
onnx_alternatives.paradee_v2e_web.onnx: v2e weights, row-drawn noise from a 2^17 table (onnxruntime-web: small session-start memory)
onnx_alternatives.paradee_v2e_web_noint8.onnx: the web file with fp32 compute (WebGPU, untested)
onnx_alternatives.paradee_v2f_lite.onnx: v2f decoder + the smaller r5_t1x text side (1.59M): ~15% faster in onnxruntime-web, 0.8 MB smaller, ~+0.1 pp WER
onnx_alternatives.paradee_v2f_lite_noint8.onnx: v2f decoder + the smaller r5_t1x text side (1.59M): ~15% faster in onnxruntime-web, 0.8 MB smaller, ~+0.1 pp WER, fp32 compute
onnx_alternatives.paradee_v2g.onnx: v2g: streamable LSTM-free text side (r5_t3sgx) + fixed-norm trunk decoder (r9sf), int8 compute
